description: Reveal the raw signing secret of a webhook. SENSITIVE: by default the MCP masks secrets (returns secretSet:true/false). This tool returns the actual secret value and is marked destructive so the MCP host prompts for approval before it runs. Use only when the user explicitly needs the secret value.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

name: gitflic_webhook_reveal_secret
